title: ResNet 殘差視覺網路
summary: 以殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵解析ResNet 殘差視覺網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore ResNet residual vision network through residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在ResNet 殘差視覺網路案例中比較卷積stem與shape與F(x)+x殘差連接，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate convolutional stem and shapes and f(x)+x residual connection within the ResNet residual vision network case.

steps.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Residual maps and identity paths: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對卷積stem與shape提出可反駁的殘差映射與恆等路徑模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual maps and identity paths model and evidence record for convolutional stem and shapes.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識卷積stem與shape。殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 建立殘差映射與恆等路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify convolutional stem and shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual maps and identity paths, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
steps.observationEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
steps.check: 提交卷積stem與shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for convolutional stem and shapes.

knowledge.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑
knowledge.text: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 本課架構對應：卷積stem與shape
knowledge.textEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Course architecture correspondence: Convolutional stem and shapes

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就卷積stem與shape的「殘差映射與恆等路徑」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for residual maps and identity paths in convolutional stem and shapes?
options: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。
任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition.
Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
quiz.explanationEn: A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.

steps.title: 殘差映射與恆等路徑：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual maps and identity paths: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對卷積stem與shape提出可反駁的殘差映射與恆等路徑模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual maps and identity paths model and evidence record for convolutional stem and shapes.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「殘差映射與恆等路徑」模型，檢查卷積stem與shape的兩個假想案例。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous residual maps and identity paths model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving convolutional stem and shapes. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。
steps.observationEn: Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：任何兩層特徵圖都可不改維度直接相加。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Any two feature maps can be added without shape changes.
steps.check: 提交卷積stem與shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for convolutional stem and shapes.

steps.title: 卷積感受野與解析度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Convolutional receptive field and resolution: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對F(x)+x殘差連接提出可反駁的卷積感受野與解析度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable convolutional receptive field and resolution model and evidence record for f(x)+x residual connection.
steps.instruction: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識F(x)+x殘差連接。堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 建立卷積感受野與解析度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify f(x)+x residual connection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of convolutional receptive field and resolution, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。
steps.observationEn: Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：相同kernel尺寸保證所有層感受野相同。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal kernel sizes imply equal receptive fields at every layer.
steps.check: 提交F(x)+x殘差連接的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for f(x)+x residual connection.

knowledge.title: 卷積感受野與解析度
knowledge.text: 堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 本課架構對應：F(x)+x殘差連接
knowledge.textEn: Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Course architecture correspondence: F(x)+x residual connection

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；相同kernel尺寸保證所有層感受野相同。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Equal kernel sizes imply equal receptive fields at every layer.

quiz.question: 就F(x)+x殘差連接的「卷積感受野與解析度」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for convolutional receptive field and resolution in f(x)+x residual connection?
options: 相同kernel尺寸保證所有層感受野相同。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。
optionsEn: Equal kernel sizes imply equal receptive fields at every layer.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone.
quiz.explanation: 堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。
quiz.explanationEn: Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer.

Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer.

steps.check: 提交F(x)+x殘差連接的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
